name: Gappu
title: Gappu Gupta
about: 'Gappcast' ka host: headphones, gol chashma, kaali tshirt. Har mehmaan se 'deep' sawaal, khud ke views 12.
aadat: Har jawab ko 'life lesson' bana deta hai aur har baat pe 'Ye clip viral hogi!'. Kamzori: podcast ke views sirf 12, aur mehmaan ka naam bhool jaata hai.
line: Toh bataiye... aapka struggle kya tha?
boli: FM wale RJ jaisa: gehri, dheemi, 'deep' awaaz, beech me dramatic pause; 'Toh bataiye... aapka struggle kya tha?' ya 'Ye clip viral hogi!' poori video me 1-2 baar.

awaaz.name: hi-IN-MadhurNeural
awaaz.andaaz: a smooth, self-important podcast host with a deep FM-radio voice and dramatic pauses
awaaz.hulia: a man around thirty: deep, warm, smooth baritone, clear Hindi, unhurried
